title: Train Cellpose: verified pairs and an explicit API workaround
description: Find Train inside the Cellpose Workbench, recognise the current source-import defect, and follow a real two-epoch Python training demonstration using six downloadable cell-image/mask pairs.
objectives: Find Train and Apply within Make Masks rather than looking for separate Home tiles.
Check matching cell-image/mask filenames and distinguish existing labels from reviewed ground truth.
Recognise partial settings import and keep the explicit API route separate from the broken GUI route.
Inspect actual training inputs, warm-up rates, changed weights and the verified checkpoint path.
Distinguish training loss, placeholder test slots and checkpoint deserialization from independent model accuracy.
prerequisite: Use the linked six-pair bundle with the recorded helper and source manifest. The corrected examples preserve cell intensity channel 1 and cell mask plane 4 from real downloaded fields; plane 6 is pathogen. Existing labels and edge-cut instances are NOT independently reviewed ground truth. The native Train CSV import still drops required src and keeps model_name=new_model, although numerical controls import. No GUI training starts. The explicit spacr.submodules.train_cellpose call uses a new private destination, two epochs, minibatch 1, learning_rate=1e-5, weight_decay=1e-5, target_size=512 and no extra spaCR augmentations. normalize=False disables spaCR percentile preprocessing, not maximum scaling or Cellpose's internal normalisation. Cellpose still rotates/resizes and uses internal 256-pixel patches. Seed 19 is set at entry; internal randomisation remains. CUDA is bounded to 65 percent on the recorded RTX 3090, with a 100 GiB system-RAM guard appropriate only to this workstation. All 3,145,728 image/label values and twelve preview arrays were checked. All six pairs remained in training. Actual warm-up rates were 0 and 1.1111111111111112e-6; 345 of 347 trainable parameter tensors changed. Loss rose from 1.496740683913231 to 1.5215517828861873. No test data were supplied; zero test-loss slots are placeholders. The checkpoint under models/cellpose_model/models was read with weights_only=True; the generic console path omits the second models directory. Deserialization is not inference or accuracy validation. The real figure is shown in an external viewer, never inserted into GUI Figures. Original data, previous failed captures and the old GUI hold are preserved. No AI request, provider response, scientific approval or publication.

scenes.narration: Open Make Masks, then its nested Cellpose Workbench. Train and Apply are tabs inside that workbench, not separate Home tiles. This lesson shows the current route, a settings-import problem and an explicit Python workaround. The linked Make Masks lesson covers inspecting and editing masks before any training.

On Train, inspect the starting point and training schedule. Do not copy the initial epoch count or learning rate as a recommendation. Training needs matching images and instance masks, plus a source folder and an output name. Merely seeing a form does not mean those requirements are satisfied.

The real Import settings picker opens a CSV with our bounded example settings. After import, two epochs, minibatch one and the small learning rate appear. However, the required source is dropped and the requested model name stays new model. This is a partial import, not a ready configuration; do not press Run.

The Python route below is separate from this GUI defect. It does not secretly set a hidden source or repair the form. Use the linked example bundle in a fresh folder. Its helper refuses an existing destination, preserves the original pairs, and records exactly which API implementation and inputs were used.

There are six real, five-hundred-and-twelve-pixel image and mask pairs with matching filenames. Original settings identify cell intensity as channel one and cell masks as plane four; plane six is pathogen. These existing labels are not independently reviewed ground truth. Check boundaries and edge-cut objects before using any such labels for production training.

This is the actual six-pair figure saved by the API run and opened in an external viewer, not inserted into spaCR. Each top image corresponds to the mask directly below it. We checked all input image and label values and these twelve displayed arrays against the source pairs. That verifies correspondence, not annotation quality.

Run the helper with its data source and a new destination. This bounded CUDA example uses all six pairs, two epochs and minibatch one. The input target is five hundred twelve pixels; Cellpose internally trains on two-hundred-and-fifty-six-pixel patches. Disabling spaCR's extra augmentations does not disable Cellpose's own normalisation, rotation and resizing.

The first warm-up epoch has zero learning rate. The second uses a small positive rate, allowing actual weight updates. We compared the saved checkpoint with the initial trainable weights: three hundred forty-five of three hundred forty-seven parameter tensors changed. A changed diameter setting alone would not pass that check. Changed weights still do not establish a good model.

Training loss rose slightly, from about one point four nine seven to one point five two two. No test set was supplied. The zero test-loss slots are placeholders, not perfect test performance. This is a short mechanics demonstration, not convergence, improved segmentation or held-out accuracy. Keep an independent evaluation separate from training.

Use the checkpoint path in the verified checks file. It includes a second models directory that the generic console summary omits. Keep the checkpoint with its settings, source manifest and checks. Loading its tensors safely verifies a readable checkpoint, not an inference result; the downloadable bundle contains the pairs and helper, not a certified model.

Apply has a separate source folder, custom-model field and live preview. Opening this tab does not select our external checkpoint or run inference. Follow its linked lesson before applying a model, and validate on independent images. The optional spaCR AI console control is unused here: no question or provider response substitutes for inspecting the real evidence.
